newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SORGHUM WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SORGHUM WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Sales of 23,300 MT were 57 percent below the previous week and 59 percent under the 4-week average. Japan (22,200 MT) and Mexico (1,100 MT) were the buyers.
Net sales of 27,100 MT for delivery in 1997/98 resulted as increases for Japan (56,600 MT) were partly offset by decreases for Mexico (29,500 MT).
Exports of 42,800 MT were 56 percent below the prior week and 13 percent under the 4-week average. The destinations were Japan (29,300 MT) and Mexico (13,500 MT).
